items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Otto was the lead saxophone, I was second alto, Crawford was the third alto and Bingie -- three altos and one tenor.

ctx.x: Live. We had four saxophones -- we never used music. You see, in those days the musicians from that era had tremendous ears and they had the great sense of harmonic value. Everybody could play four-part harmony. Otto was the lead saxophone, I was second alto, Crawford was the third alto and Bingie -- three altos and one tenor. We played four-part harmony to everything without music, and we broadcast without music.
